name: kage-legacy
description: Kage Legacy — Manager d'escouade shinobi asynchrone

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run audit:imports --prefix backend && npm run test:daily-seal --prefix backend && npm run test:pool-schedule --prefix backend && npm run test:narrative --prefix backend && npm run test:causal-debrief --prefix backend
scripts.e2e:prepare: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run e2e:ensure-player --prefix backend
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/killDevPorts.js && start-server-and-test "npm run dev" http://localhost:5173 "cypress run"
scripts.test:e2e:open: node scripts/killDevPorts.js && start-server-and-test "npm run dev" http://localhost:5173 "cypress open"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:up && sleep 8 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
